outcome_boundaries.security_success: famous winner designation retrospective; exact 2018-entry total return not calculated

cases.compatibility: Exposure and early platform thesis are compatible. Revenue/profit outcome does not validate all robotaxi timing, margin or terminal-multiple assumptions.
cases.independent_lesson: Separate innovation recognition, financing/valuation precision and portfolio risk. A winning security can contain wrong component forecasts.

chain.evidence: Innovation viewed as deep value; deflation central to outlook and five-year return expectation broadly stated.
Worst-quarter return appears in official prospectus history.
2022 fund total-return loss, followed by recovery years.
Five-year trailing return comparison discloses substantial benchmark shortfall.

cases.compatibility: A severe one-year loss conflicts with capital-preservation use, but does not alone disprove an unfinished broad-strategy five-year forecast. The exact late-2021 investment cohort and revised statement cannot be equated to all ARKK holders.
cases.independent_lesson: Test discount-rate duration, liquidity, correlated forecasts, dilution and survivability explicitly. Do not turn drawdown into permission to add without updated underwriting.

thought_position_audit.finding: Persistent reported Tesla ownership fits the thesis; later stock success does not establish original simulated probabilities were calibrated.
Deep-value outlook preceded a severe fund decline; growth research alone did not contain portfolio drawdown risk.
Daily trim/add decisions, cash, hedges, every account and actual investor P&L were not reconstructed.

license_and_reuse.general: Use facts and independently worded ideas with citations. Original prose, artwork, slide layouts, workbook/formulas, source code or prompt text are separate copyrighted materials; public accessibility is not a copying license.
license_and_reuse.prompt_code: No investor-authored prompt code was recovered or executed. Do not label newly authored Skill prompts as the investor's exact instructions.
license_and_reuse.model_license: CC BY-NC 4.0 per official README; commercial copying/use requires written permission. Attribution still required for permitted noncommercial reuse.
license_and_reuse.implementation: Independently write new sensitivity models and prompts; cite the idea/model lineage. Do not copy workbook formulas, formatting or repository content into a commercial Skill without permission/licensing review.
